About Our Brand & Products

Our products are doctor-formulated by Dr. Talin Mirzakhanian, DAcCHM, L.Ac., a California-licensed Doctor of Acupuncture with a Chinese Herbal Medicine specialization and founder of Roots & Needles Acupuncture Clinic in Glendale, CA.

Each product is developed from a Traditional Chinese Medicine clinical perspective, combining time-tested herbal therapeutics with modern, clean formulation standards. Our Herbal Pain Relief Butter is crafted in small batches using therapeutic-grade butters, high-potency herbal infusions, and carefully balanced cooling actives for fast-acting, deep relief.

This product is:

  • External-use only

  • Clean, non-toxic, and cruelty-free

  • Made without parabens, phthalates, petroleum, or synthetic fragrances

  • Designed for effectiveness using herbal extract infusion, not just surface sensation of menthol

What Makes Us Different

  • Doctor-Formulated & Clinic-Tested
    Developed by a licensed practitioner and refined through real patient feedback.

  • Herbal-First Approach
    Our formulas rely on traditional Chinese pain-relief herbs, not just menthol or fragrance.

  • Balanced Strength
    Powerful without harsh burning, irritation, or numbing overload.

  • Small-Batch Quality
    Each batch is carefully produced for consistency, freshness, and potency.

  • Transparent Formulation
    No white-label shortcuts. No filler formulas. Every ingredient has a purpose.

How Affiliates Can Earn

Affiliates earn commission on every sale made through their unique referral link.

  • Commission is paid on completed purchases

  • Earnings grow as your audience grows

  • No cap on how much you can earn

  • Real product with repeat-purchase potential

(Exact commission percentage, payout schedule, and minimums are provided upon approval.)

How to Promote Us

Affiliates may promote our products through:

  • Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, or other social platforms

  • Blog posts or newsletters

  • Practitioner or wellness referrals

  • Personal testimonials and demonstrations

  • Educational content (how it works, when to use it, who it’s for)

We encourage authentic sharing show how you use the product, who you recommend it to, and why it stands out.

Affiliates must:

  • Clearly disclose affiliate partnerships

  • Avoid medical claims or disease-treatment language

  • Represent the brand accurately and respectfully

Other Information

  • Affiliates must be approved before receiving a referral link

  • Brand assets (images, product descriptions, usage guidance) are provided

  • We reserve the right to remove affiliates who misuse claims or branding

  • This is not an MLM — there are no tiers or downlines

  • External-use product only; not intended to diagnose or treat disease
